sentence: Among Chinese listed firms, data assets carry roughly 45.6 percent of the total value effect of AI adoption
passage: [Shi et al. (2025), p. 7] "The comparable magnitudes of direct (0.0483) and indirect (0.0405) effects suggest that data assets mediate approximately 45.6\% of AI adoption's total effect on firm value, highlighting the substantial role of data assets in translating AI capabilities into enterprise value."

gemini.note: The passage supports the 45.6 percent mediation effect but does not explicitly state that this applies to Chinese listed firms.
